construction: Authored standalone cargo trouser volume with a continuous joined seat and two straight legs; all geometry is authored for this order.

referenceSource.role: Silhouette reference only. No source mesh, texture, logo, patch, or label is included in the authored garment.

revisionChanges: Added eight raised belt-loop straps crossing both waistband edges, distributed around the waist so they read in front, back, side, and oblique views.
Added cuff eyelet exits and two short knotted drawcord ends per hem, visible from front and back while remaining attached at each channel.

uv.coverage: All mesh vertices carry UVs; detail panels use local panel UV and the body uses planar world-space projection.
uv.limitations: Front/back UV overlap is not intended for artwork placement. The gray review has no texture maps; Material must preserve UVs and wait for independent shape QA pass before surface work.

displayEnvelopeCm.source: tools/showcase-glb.mjs primitives() world-space bounds of authored GLB
displayEnvelopeCm.meaning: Display envelope only, not apparel or sewing size.

review.previewCaption: Geometry quần cargo được dựng độc lập; JNCO chỉ tham chiếu silhouette, không kế thừa geometry, logo hoặc nhãn.
